name: sol_basics_inheritance_3
description: Contract declares an interface but fails to implement all its required functions
question: The source file in `source` declares that a contract implements a given interface (via inheritance, `is InterfaceName`, or similar) but omits the implementation of one or more functions required by that interface, or implements a required function with a mismatched signature, so calls made through the interface type revert or behave unexpectedly.
criteria: A contract declares `is IERC20` or another named interface but does not define one of the interface's required functions (e.g. missing `transferFrom`)
A contract inherits an interface and implements a required function with a different signature (wrong parameter types or return type) than the interface declares
A contract implements an interface function but omits required return values specified by the interface, causing callers decoding the return data to revert or misinterpret results
A contract claims ERC-165 support for an interface ID via `supportsInterface` without actually implementing all of that interface's required functions
